I am 60 years old and have been farming this land for many years. Beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil, and at my age I watch my costs carefully. However, cowpea suffers badly from insect damage here in the North West, so I must buy some pesticide to protect the pods, otherwise the yield is lost. My family can manage the planting, weeding, and harvesting on this 0.55 hectare plot without hiring extra hands.
